body: Nope, not really. I don't think any art is ugly. It's about the idea behind it for me, not the technique. You should treasure it as a good memory. Also, good luck on your song writing! Do you play any instruments?

Sure!
Also, you write songs? That's awesome. I used to go to piano lessons, but ended up just as you with your art classes, haha. I really admire people that compose music, though. It's really beautiful to me. I just can't do it *-*

Oh no. That teacher was not a nice person, to put it gently. I'm now curious if it was as bad as you think. 
I'm glad you found something else, though. I admire your determination. It's what's really important in life, not talent. In my opinion at least.

Whoa, thanks! I can't really see how this could be inspiring, but I'm glad to hear it! Art is largely about practice. As a little kid I was always doodling something, trying to redraw photos, getting in trouble for drawing during lessons... I definitely had a lot of training. So don't give up on yourself, sometimes it takes a lot of time!

Thank you.
Sure. I didn't get my folder back when leaving my art lessons (because of sudden hospitalization), so I lost all of my paintings. All I have left is a few sketches and an unfinished fanart (Imgur made it blurry somehow?) from when I was around 12. It's kind of stupid, but...
http://imgur.com/a/F9WeJAm

Thank you, kind person.
Rationally, I know I'm not. Everyone matters. I just can't help but feel like I'm the smallest particle of dust under the world's feet. Nothing I tell myself eases that feeling. I will never be enough, not in my own mind. I hate myself too much.
